learning_outcomes.text: Outlines the structure of internal combustion engines.
Compares different engine types and calculates engine performance parameters.
Calculates cycle parameters in internal combustion engines.
Explains the combustion event in engines.
Explains exhaust emissions and their formation mechanisms in engines.

syllabus_topics: Classification and operating principles of internal combustion engines
Basic concepts related to engines and engine operating principles
Ideal cycles of internal combustion engines
Problem-solving related to ideal cycles of internal combustion engines
Fuel-air cycles of internal combustion engines
Real cycles of internal combustion engines
Fuels used in engines, their production and characteristics
Combustion stoichiometry and combustion in engines
